method: WebFetch of the three official 2027 course pages on qmul.ac.uk (courses/2027/physics, biomedical-engineering, materials-science-and-engineering), fetched with a harmless query string because the bare URLs returned "Too many redirects"; each variant has its own fee box headed "Start: September 2027". Cross-checked that the 2026 page (F300: Home £9,790 / Overseas £32,950) differs, so pages were not stale. The general QMUL undergraduate tuition fees page (tuitionfees/) is out of date (2025-26 wording) and was not used.
